# Jacob Paul Construction

> Licensed kitchen and bath remodeling contractor based in Newtown, Connecticut, serving
> Danbury and greater Fairfield County. Kitchen remodeling, bathroom remodeling, custom
> cabinetry and countertops, tile and stone, trim and finish carpentry, and fixture
> installation — plus decks and custom closet and storage systems built by the same crew.
> Family-owned, 15+ years, free estimates.

## Contact
- Address: 80 Main St, Newtown, CT, United States

- Licensed and insured

## Services
- Kitchen Remodeling — layout and work-triangle redesign, full gut renovations, islands, pantries and appliance fit
- Bathroom Remodeling — tub-to-shower conversions, curbless and wet-room showers, vanities, niches and heated floors
- Custom Cabinetry & Countertops — custom and semi-custom cabinetry, quartz, granite and butcher block, templating, fabrication and install
- Tile, Stone & Backsplashes — shower pans and waterproofing, backsplashes and feature walls, large-format, mosaic and heated floors
- Trim, Millwork & Finish Carpentry — crown, base and casing, built-ins, benches and open shelving, door and window trim-out
- Plumbing, Lighting & Fixtures — supply and waste relocation, under-cabinet and recessed lighting, faucets, sinks and vent fans
- Decks & Outdoor Living — hardwood and composite decking, cable, timber and composite railings, stairs, landings and walkways
- Custom Closets & Storage — walk-in and reach-in closet systems, built-in wardrobes and drawer banks, media walls and storage joinery

## Typical timelines
Bathrooms run 3–5 weeks and kitchens 6–10 weeks, demolition to punch list. Custom cabinetry and
stone carry lead times and are ordered early; a dated schedule comes with every estimate.

## Service area
Newtown, Danbury, Bethel, New Fairfield, Brookfield, Ridgefield, and greater Fairfield County, CT.

## Reputation
4.8 out of 5 from 67 Google reviews.
